facts: Parties: Whitlock Technologies Ltd (Company) and Yarrow Holdings Securities (Underwriter).

Clause 9: the Underwriters may offer the Shares to investors in the United States, Canada and the European Economic Area. No selling restrictions or exemption conditions are specified for any jurisdiction.
Clause 4: the Company grants the Underwriters an option to purchase up to 4,800,000 additional shares (the Over-allotment Option), representing 15% of the 24,000,000 Firm Shares.
Recital C: the Company has 45,700,000 ordinary shares in issue.
Issuer: Whitlock Technologies Ltd. The date of this Prospectus is 1 November 2026.
Use of Proceeds: net proceeds of $120,000,000 will be applied as follows: repayment of the revolving facility $54,000,000; capital expenditure $36,000,000; general corporate purposes $38,000,000.
Capitalisation: 45,200,000 ordinary shares are in issue at the date of this Prospectus.
